QuestInfo.name: The Ingredients for the Flying Medicine
QuestInfo.0: It doesn't seem easy to talk to #p309#.
QuestInfo.1: I met #p309# in #m10002000#, and he REALLY doesn't seem to like people. As a whole. How did he and Icarus become best friends in the first place? Anyway, in order to make the #b#t4031079##k, he needs #b50 #t4000039##k and #b20 #t4031012#s#k. That's really all it takes to fly?
QuestInfo.2: As #p309# asked, I got him the #t4000039# and #t4031012# items. Can he make the #t4031079# with these?

0.0: What's a human doing here? I have nothing to say to you. Please leave.\r\n#L0# #bI don't think I want to talk to you, either!\r\n#L1# About the Flying Medicine...#k#l
0.1: Hey, how does a human like you know about that? Well, even if you know of it, I don't think I feel like talking about it with someone like you! \r\n#L0# #bYou are one rude, despicable kid!!\r\n#L1# I really need that medicine, though.#k#l
0.2:
What?!! A kid? Trust me, I am NOT a kid!! !!
#L0# #bSorry, didn't mean to be rude.
#L1# Aren't you much too young to talk to me like that anyway?
#L2# I wouldn't even be here if not for #p407#...#l#k
0.3: #p407#? You're here for him? He's my only human friend... All right, since you're here at his request, I'll make you the medicine. You should know that the ingredients I need are really hard to find. I wonder if you're even qualified to gather them all up.

yes.0: Okay. You seem like the kind of person that really cares about promises made with friends. You might not be as bad as I thought. Get me #b50 #t4000039##k and #b20 #t4031012#s#k, and I'll make you the #b#t4031079##k. The Witchgrass Leaf grows in swamps, and it's not the easiest to extract. You HAVE to #bextract from the right side#k, if you want to do it right. Good luck with that.

no.0: I knew it. It's way too tough for a weakling like you. At least you're aware of your limits. Now get out of here!

1.1: Whether you need it or not, that's your business, not mine.

2.0: Get out of my face. Bye!
2.1: Hey, you're talking to a fairy! Of course I've been alive much longer than you have! In any case, I don't feel like talking to you, so just leave!

1.0: Whoa, you got them all? What's this? The leaves are dry! How am I going to make the #t4031079# with crappy ingredients like this? \r\n#L0# #bHey, what's your problem??\r\n#L1# They look fine to me.#k#l
1.1: What are you trying to say? You don't even know what you're talking about! I'll use these for now, but it's not my responsibility if it comes out less than perfect. The ingredients you got me STINK!

item.0: Were you even listening to what I was saying? I need #b50 #t4000039##k and #b20 #t4031012#s#k! Get it??
